focus: Per-gap verdicts, smallest changes, and the deletion/merge surface
noveltyJustification: 6 of 10 findings were new facts (the probe inventory, the Codex probe status, the repo's own Codex hooks, the test-pinned runtime list, the test-to-implementation ratio, the third process-filter copy); 4 were synthesis of prior evidence.
keyQuestions: Which of the eight known gaps are worth closing, and what is the smallest change that closes each one?
Which gaps close by removing a surface (an adapter, a sweep, a runtime-matrix row) instead of adding code?
What does each runtime actually expose for live capture, and are the Cursor "unverified" and Hermes "absent" rows worth filling or deleting?
What test coverage guards the capture path today, and which single refactor collapses the most duplicated tests?

label: The probe folder holds four probes (codex, devin, opencode, pi) and none for Cursor, so the matrix's "unverified" Cursor cell records an unscheduled experiment rather than an observed absence.

The Codex probe records the hook as observed working and then attributes the missing hook to per-user trust, so the matrix's "by-design" cell describes a policy choice made after the capability was demonstrated.

The trust objection does not separate decision capture from already-shipped hooks: .codex/hooks.json registers three PostToolUse and four Stop commands today, so a Codex user already trusts this repository's hooks.
The Codex probe already documents the live payload shape a hook would see, so a Codex adapter needs only the mapping the sweep already performs, not new schema discovery.

The coverage matrix is test-pinned to exactly six runtimes: runtime-refusal.test.mjs hard-codes the six names and asserts six cells, so adding a Hermes column is a test edit as well as a documentation edit.
That same test accepts "unverified:" as a valid reason-bearing terminal state, so it guards the form of a cell and never its resolution, which is why an unverified cell can persist indefinitely.
The documented runtime-state contract already names the probe folder, so recording a Cursor probe needs no new file kind and no new documentation page.
The test surface is larger than the implementation it guards (4,868 test lines, 64 sweep tests), and each of the five sweep suites re-asserts chat_candidates and queue behaviour for its own store.

The process-question rule exists in three places (the executable filter, the save instruction, the runtime-state README) and only the executable copy is testable, so the other two are the copies that drift.

Each sweep owns a store locator as well as a turn extractor and record mapper, so the shared seams are capture-core and chat-questions and the last duplicated layer is turn extraction, which one turn contract would collapse.

reason: The matrix is pinned by a test constant, Hermes has no adapter and no probe, and the column would document an absence with no plan to fill it.
The decided sentence is the product value of the record; a templated sentence fills decision-record.md with prose no reader can act on.
